quarterly_data.signal: Cowboy Space Corp. (based in San Carlos, CA and Seattle, WA) is building an integrated system of satellites and rockets to haul high-performance compute and optical data transmission down from Low Earth Orbit; it integrates a megawatt-class data center into the upper stage of its launch vehicle - a 1-megawatt data center with active thermal management and integrated compute ('We own the launch, we own the infrastructure').
